newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela extends Corimon stock suspension.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela extends Corimon stock suspension.

text.p: Public trading of Corimon shares on the Caracas stock exchange has been suspended for another month until October 31, Venezuela's National Securities Commission (CNV) said Tuesday in a press release.
The CNV did not give a reason for the extended suspension, which first took effect in February as the company struggled to overcome financial problems.
Corimon has since restructured its $100 million in debts, recently filing with the CNV for a resumption of public trade in its stock.
